scope_zh: G198架构团队角色与技能框架

inputs_outputs.text_zh: 输入架构指引，输出可交付构件设计；设计师侧重技术实现。

evidence.quote_en: translate the architecture into deliverable components

hierarchy_notice_zh: 架构领导/治理、专业范围或协作关系不自动表示人事直属汇报；岗位、角色、任务分别建模。
qualification_notice_zh: 学历、工作年限、认证、法定签字权等未在相应证据给出时保持未规定，不能从技能等级推造。

proficiency_reference_notice.text_zh: 每项技能等级为框架的期望熟练程度；用于发现能力匹配与缺口，非当前人员已满足要求的证据。

evidence.quote_en: desirable level of proficiency in each skill

analysis_zh: 本角色用完整79项技能列分析能力重点。G198没有为每个矩阵列分别写完整职位说明，明确职责只能由下列直接证据或注明来源的补充语境支持。 设计师与架构师技能有交集，但把构件交付设计与企业架构完整性责任区分。

proficiency_scale.description_en: Not a required skill, but could be useful.
Understands the background, issues, and implications sufficiently to be able to understand how to proceed further and advise stakeholders accordingly.
Detailed knowledge of subject area and capable of providing professional advice and guidance. Ability to integrate capability into architecture design.
Extensive and substantial practical experience and applied knowledge on the subject.

competency_analysis.method: distribution and category comparison of the complete source column; ordinal levels are not a person score
competency_analysis.application_zh: 以每项技能的参考等级与个人可核实经验逐项比较；不足项形成培训/专家支持/协作计划。不要把表中等级求和作为招聘或晋升合格线。
